actions.name: Through Ball
actions.successMeaning: Pass reaches the intended teammate in the targeted space.

actions.name: Dribble
actions.successMeaning: Player retains possession while beating the immediate defender.

actions.name: Control
actions.successMeaning: Player brings the ball under control.

actions.name: Contain
actions.successMeaning: Player prevents the opponent advancing past the defensive line for this action.

actions.name: Save
actions.successMeaning: Goalkeeper prevents the shot becoming a goal.

actions.name: Claim
actions.successMeaning: Goalkeeper secures possession of the incoming ball.

actions.name: Distribute
actions.successMeaning: Goalkeeper delivery reaches the intended teammate.

actions.name: Corner
actions.successMeaning: Corner delivery reaches the intended teammate.

actions.name: Clear
actions.successMeaning: Ball leaves the immediate danger area.

meetings.opening: Your coach invites you to review your place in the team. What will you work on next? Your stated training focus is saved even if the coach doubts your argument; the check decides the response.

choices.text: Commit to the skills your assigned role needs
choices.successText: The coach appreciates a clear plan. Your default training focus now follows your assigned role.
choices.failureText: Your plan is recorded, but the coach wants to see reliable attendance before offering more trust.

choices.successText: The coach supports your tailored plan. Your selected focus will be the default for future training.
choices.failureText: Your focus is recorded. The coach is unconvinced and expects you to demonstrate its value.

choices.text: Push back: judge me by results
choices.successText: The coach respects your confidence but dislikes your refusal to make a plan. Your training focus stays as it was.
choices.failureText: The challenge damages trust. Your training focus stays as it was.

meetings.opening: After training, a teammate asks whether you see the squad as partners or competition. Your answer can create a friendship, a rivalry, or a professional understanding.

choices.text: Offer to help each other improve
choices.successText: You agree to support each other. A friendship begins.
choices.failureText: They appreciate the gesture but remain cautious. There is room to build a friendship.

choices.text: Make it clear you want their place
choices.successText: They respect your ambition but take the challenge personally. A rivalry begins.
choices.failureText: The confrontation lands badly. You have made a rival and lost professional trust.

choices.successText: You agree to compete fairly and work together on the pitch.
choices.failureText: They accept your boundaries, but want to see how you behave.

meetings.opening: Your agent asks what matters most in your next career step. The preference you state is always recorded; the check determines how convincingly you communicate it. Future opportunities will primarily come through your agent. No transfer or contract negotiation takes place in this prototype.

choices.successText: Your agent agrees to prioritize meaningful minutes over club prestige.
choices.failureText: Your priority is recorded, but your agent asks you to communicate more clearly next time.

choices.successText: Your agent understands: strong development conditions matter, even if minutes are harder to earn.
choices.failureText: Your development priority is recorded. Your agent wants evidence that you will commit to the work.

choices.successText: Your agent respects your ambition and records a preference for the highest challenge.
choices.failureText: Your ambition is recorded, but the agent doubts your current readiness. No opportunity is promised.
